EV.3.requirement: Power measured by the event Energy Meter must stay at or below the limit.
EV.3.title: Maximum power

EV.3.requirement: Voltage between any two points must stay at or below the limit.
EV.3.title: Maximum voltage

EV.3.requirement: The powertrain must not regenerate below the speed threshold.
EV.3.title: Low-speed regeneration

EV.3.requirement: A power or voltage excursion counts once it persists continuously for the dwell time, or once a moving average over the averaging window exceeds the limit.
EV.3.title: What counts as a violation

EV.3.requirement: The second test applies a moving average over this window.
EV.3.title: Violation moving-average window

EV.3.requirement: Each violation during Endurance carries a time penalty.
EV.3.title: Endurance penalty

EV.3.requirement: All tractive-system power must flow through the event Energy Meter.
EV.3.title: Energy Meter in the path

EV.3.requirement: Driving the vehicle in reverse under motor power is prohibited.
EV.3.title: Reverse

EV.3.requirement: Any control unit adjusting requested wheel torque may only reduce the driver's request, never increase it.
EV.3.title: Torque algorithms

EV.4.requirement: Motors must connect to the tractive battery through a motor controller; no direct connection.
EV.4.title: Motor controller

EV.4.requirement: Plausibility fails when the mechanical brakes are engaged while the accelerator signals more than this share of pedal travel.
EV.4.title: APPS / brake plausibility trip

EV.4.requirement: After a trip, motor power stays shut down until the accelerator falls below this share of pedal travel.
EV.4.title: APPS / brake plausibility reset

EV.4.requirement: Each tractive battery container must carry the school name and vehicle number, the ISO 7010-W012 warning symbol at the minimum triangle size, and the required text.
EV.4.title: Container labelling

EV.5.requirement: Each module's static voltage must stay at or below the limit.
EV.5.title: Module static voltage

EV.5.requirement: Each module's contained energy must stay at or below the limit, computed as maximum stack voltage times nominal cell capacity.
EV.5.title: Module energy

EV.5.requirement: Each module's mass must stay at or below the limit.
EV.5.title: Module mass

EV.5.requirement: Every tractive battery pack needs at least one fuse and two or more normally-open isolation relays opening both poles.
EV.5.title: Isolation relays and fuse

EV.5.requirement: A capacitor may hold the isolation relays closed after shutdown for no longer than this.
EV.5.title: Relay hold-up

EV.5.requirement: The manual service disconnect must sit above this height from the ground.
EV.5.title: MSD height

EV.5.requirement: An untrained person must be able to operate the manual service disconnect within this time, without tools or removing bodywork.
EV.5.title: MSD operation time

EV.5.requirement: The precharge circuit must bring the intermediate circuit to at least this share of tractive-system voltage before the second isolation relay closes.
EV.5.title: Precharge target

EV.5.requirement: The discharge circuit must handle maximum tractive-system voltage for at least this long.
EV.5.title: Discharge circuit rating

EV.5.requirement: The precharge relay must be a mechanical type.
EV.5.title: Precharge relay type

EV.8.requirement: The insulation monitoring device's response value must be set at or above this, relative to the maximum tractive-system voltage.
EV.8.title: IMD response value

EV.8.requirement: The brake-system plausibility device must open the shutdown circuit when hard braking coincides with tractive-system current corresponding to this DC power at nominal pack voltage, for longer than the dwell.
EV.8.title: BSPD trip

EV.8.requirement: The BSPD trip condition must persist longer than this before the shutdown circuit opens.
EV.8.title: BSPD dwell

EV.8.requirement: The BMS, IMD and BSPD branches of the shutdown circuit must be normally open and mutually independent.
EV.8.title: Shutdown branches normally open

T.9.requirement: Voltage above this counts as high voltage and pulls in the labelling and isolation requirements.
T.9.title: High voltage threshold

rules.requirement: Motors must connect to the tractive battery through a motor controller; no direct connection.

rules.requirement: Plausibility fails when the mechanical brakes are engaged while the accelerator signals more than this share of pedal travel.
rules.title: APPS / brake plausibility trip

rules.requirement: After a trip, motor power stays shut down until the accelerator falls below this share of pedal travel.
rules.title: APPS / brake plausibility reset

rules.requirement: Each tractive battery container must carry the school name and vehicle number, the ISO 7010-W012 warning symbol at the minimum triangle size, and the required text.
rules.title: Container labelling

rules.requirement: Each module's static voltage must stay at or below the limit.
rules.title: Module static voltage

rules.requirement: Each module's contained energy must stay at or below the limit, computed as maximum stack voltage times nominal cell capacity.
rules.title: Module energy

rules.requirement: Each module's mass must stay at or below the limit.
rules.title: Module mass

rules.requirement: Every tractive battery pack needs at least one fuse and two or more normally-open isolation relays opening both poles.
rules.title: Isolation relays and fuse

rules.requirement: A capacitor may hold the isolation relays closed after shutdown for no longer than this.
rules.title: Relay hold-up

rules.requirement: The manual service disconnect must sit above this height from the ground.
rules.title: MSD height

rules.requirement: An untrained person must be able to operate the manual service disconnect within this time, without tools or removing bodywork.
rules.title: MSD operation time

rules.requirement: The precharge circuit must bring the intermediate circuit to at least this share of tractive-system voltage before the second isolation relay closes.
rules.title: Precharge target

rules.requirement: The discharge circuit must handle maximum tractive-system voltage for at least this long.
rules.title: Discharge circuit rating

rules.requirement: The precharge relay must be a mechanical type.
rules.title: Precharge relay type

rules.requirement: The insulation monitoring device's response value must be set at or above this, relative to the maximum tractive-system voltage.
rules.title: IMD response value

rules.requirement: The brake-system plausibility device must open the shutdown circuit when hard braking coincides with tractive-system current corresponding to this DC power at nominal pack voltage, for longer than the dwell.
rules.title: BSPD trip

rules.requirement: The BSPD trip condition must persist longer than this before the shutdown circuit opens.
rules.title: BSPD dwell

rules.requirement: The BMS, IMD and BSPD branches of the shutdown circuit must be normally open and mutually independent.
rules.title: Shutdown branches normally open

rules.requirement: Voltage above this counts as high voltage and pulls in the labelling and isolation requirements.
rules.title: High voltage threshold
